description: Variation of Condition 35 (Residents parking permits) of planning permission 00607/BN/S1 dated 12/03/2020 for demolition of existing building and redevelopment of site to provide 96 residential dwellings together with the provision of flexible commercial floorspace (Class A1/A2/A3/A4/B1&D1 use) with associated public realm improvements, landscaping and car parking.
site_name: Land South Of Brentford High Street And Waterside
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be began before the expiration of three years from the date of planning application 00607/BN/S1 dated 12 March 2020.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved for materials under application reference 00607/BN/S1(2i) dated 24/08/2022 and maintained as such thereafter.

Condition : 3 - 3	Detailed applications
The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([00]A 001 Rev. A, [00]A 002 Rev. A, [00]A 003 Rev. Covering letter dated 27th July 2022; BBD-BDP-ZZ-XX-DR-A-00003-P05 Proposed Site Plan with Original Site Boundary; BBD-BDP-ZZ-XX-DR-A-00002-P03 Existing Site Plan; BBD-BDP-ZZ-XX-DR-A-00001-P02 Site Location Plan; BBD-BDP-ZZ-08-DR-A-20008-C01 GA Roof Plan; BBD-BDP-ZZ-01-DR-A-20001-P05 GA Plan Level 01; BBD-BDP-ZZ-00-DR-A-20000-C02-GA Plan Level 00; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20506-C01 GA Section FF; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20505-C01 GA Section EE; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20504-C01 GA Section DD; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20503-C01 GA Section CC; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20502-C01 GA Section BB; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20501-C01 GA Section AA; BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20402-C01 GA Elevations 2 (North - South); BBD-BDP-XX-ZZ-DR-A-20401-C01 GA Elevations 1 (East - West); BBD-BDP-W-07-DR-A-20307-C02- DA Plan Block W Level 07; BBD-BDP-W-06-DR-A-20306-C03- DA Plan Block W Level 06; BBD-BDP-W-05-DR-A-20305-C02- DA Plan Block W Level 05; BBD-BDP-W-04-DR-A-20304-C02 DA Plan Block W Level 04; BBD-BDP-W-03-DR-A-20303-C02 DA Plan Block W Level 03; BBD-BDP-W-02-DR-A-20302-C03 DA Plan Block W Level 02; BBD-BDP-N-05-DR-A-20205-C01- DA Plan Block N Level 05a; BBD-BDP-N-04-DR-A-20204-C02- DA Plan Block N Level 04a; BBD-BDP-N-03-DR-A-20203-C02- DA Plan Block N Level 03a; BBD-BDP-N-02-DR-A-20202-C02 DA P

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the delivery and servicing plan approved under application 00607/BN/S1(5-20) dated 14/10/2021.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the demolition and construction management and logistics plan approved under application 00607/BN/S1(6,28i) dated 08/12/2021.
Condition : 7 - No external ventilation or ducting shall be implemented without written approval from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hard and soft landscaping details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(8-9) dated 27/07/2022.

Condition : 9 - The development shall achieve an 'Excellent' rating under BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) for the Shell/Shell and Core stage and an 'Excellent' rating under BREEAM Refurbishment and Fit-out 2014 as demonstrated within application 00607/BN/S1(8-9) dated 27/07/2022. 

a)	Within 6 months of work starting on site, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Shell and Core Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building Research Establishment (BRE), shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating will be achieved. 

b)	Within 3 months of first occupation of the development, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Shell and Core Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that an 'Excellent' rating has been achieved. All the measures integrated shall be retained for the lifetime of the development. 

c)	Prior to commencement of the fit-out of the development, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing, a BREEAM Refurbishment and Fit-out 2014 Parts 3 and 4 Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the BRE, must be submitted, by the fit-out contractor, to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum 'Excellent' rating will be achieved. 

d)	d) Within 3 months of first occupation, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority in writing, a BREEAM Refurbishment and Fit-out 2014 Parts 3 and 4 Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE, must be submitted, by the fit-out contractor, to and approved in writing by the Local Planning

Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the energy strategy approved under application 00607/BN/S1(10,22) dated 15/10/2021. The agreed Energy Strategy shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of any residential unit.
Condition : 11 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the energy evidence details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(11) dated 02/11/2023.

Condition : 12 - The cycle parking approved under application 00607/BN/S1(12) dated 28/04/2023 shall be installed prior to occupation of the relevant units to which the cycle parking spaces relate and retained permanently thereafter in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. [20]A 100 Rev. H and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 14 - The car parking areas shall be managed in accordance with the car park management plan approved under application 00607/BN/S1(5-20) dated 14/10/2021 for the duration of the development.

Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details and written validation (closure) report submitted under applications 00607/BN/S1(15) dated 12/10/2021 and 00607/BN/S1(15d) dated 16/10/2023 in regards to contamination.

Condition : 16 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development biodiversity enhancements shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(16,27) dated 19/10/2021.

Condition : 17 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. All such fixed external plant shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans. No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant that are not shown on the approved plans shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - A minimum of 10% of all dwellings to be constructed as part of the development shall be built to requirement M4(3) wheelchair user dwellings contained within Part M volume 1 of the Building Regulations, as identified on the plans approved under condition 2. All other dwellings shall be built to requirement M4(2) accessible and adaptable dwellings contained within Part M volume 1 of the Building Regulations.

Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the carriageway and footway details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(19) dated 13/10/2023 prior to first occupation of any unit.

Condition : 20 - The Residential and Commercial Travel Plans approved under application 00607/BN/S1(5-20) dated 14/10/2021 shall be brought into effect upon first occupation of the hereby approved development and shall continue in permanent operation thereafter, subject to any reviews and adjustments agreed with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 21 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Affordable Housing Scheme approved under application 00607/BN/S1(21) dated 29/07/2021 and shall be retained as such in perpetuity.
Condition : 22 - The Carbon offset contribution has been made and confirmed under application 00607/BN/S1(10,22) dated 15/10/2021.
Condition : 23 - The development shall be constructed in accordance with the Fire Safety Statement approved under application 00607/BN/S1(23) dated 13/10/2021.
Condition : 24 - The development shall be constructed in accordance with the water supply infrastructure details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(24) dated 13/10/2021.

Condition : 25 - The development has achieved 'Secured by Design' accreditation awarded by the Design-Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the Association of Chief Police Officers (ACPO) as approved under application 00607/BN/S1(25) dated 23/01/2024.

Condition : 26 - The arrangement for storing waste and recyclable materials shall not be carried out otherwise that in accordance with the details approved under application 00607/BN/S1(26) dated 22/06/2023 and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 27 - The Bird Hazard Management Plan approved under application 00607/BN/S1(16,27) dated 19/10/2021 shall be implemented as approved on completion of the development and shall remain in force for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 28 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the archaeological details submitted under applications 00607/BN/S1(28) dated 20/09/2021, 00607/BN/S1(6,28i) dated 08/12/2021 and 00607/BN/S1(28D) dated 16/10/2023. 

A comprehensive written report of the archaeological investigations must be completed and published within three years of the completion of development and a copy provided to the Greater London Historic Environment Record.

Condition : 29 - The ventilation and noise insulation measures approved under application 00607/BN/S1(29-31) dated 01/11/2022 shall be installed prior to the occupation of the residential units and thereafter retained.

Condition : 30 - The ground floor level Class A1-A4, D1 and B1 premises, as shown on the approved drawings (now Class E(a), E(b), E(c), E(g) and Class F.1) shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of 0700 and 2300 Mondays to Saturdays, and 0800 to 2100 Sundays and Public Holidays and at no other times, unless otherwise approved, in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 31 - The CCTV strategy approved under application 00607/BN/S1(29-31) dated 01/11/2022 shall be completed prior to the first occupation of any residential unit and shall be maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 32 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted documents as referenced below: 
- Brentford Waterside Block D, Flood Risk Assessment, reference HBD-C-BDP-ZZ-ZZ-RP-C-0001, revision C, dated 7 February 2020, prepared by BDP. 
- Drawing [21] A 011, East West Elevations, Issue B Planning Issue Ground Flr Levels Raised to Environment Agency Advice, dated 7 February 2020, prepared by BDP. 
- Drawing [21] A 010, North South Elevations, Issue C Planning Issue Ground Flr Levels Raised to Environment Agency Advice, dated 7 February 2020, prepared by BDP. 
Furthermore, the development shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures detailed in the submitted documents: 
- Tidal flood defences will be raised during the proposed development to the 2065 (6.25mAOD) in line with the TE2100 Plan as outlined in submitted drawings and the FRA. 
- A continuous, fit for purpose flood defence at the agreed 2065 (6.25m AOD) height along the south of the site will be achieved and maintained as outlined in the FRA. 
- All proposed entry points will be located at a level of 6.25m AOD and above providing safe access to Brentford High Street through Bradsbury Yard and Catherine Wheel Yard in the event of flooding, and in line with the access and egress plan as per Appendix J of the FRA.
Condition : 33 - The development has been carried out in accordance with the evidence of sustainable construction approved under application 00607/BN/S1(33) dated 11/08/2023.
Condition : 34 - The development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less as approved under application 00607/BN/S1(34) dated 27/10/2023.

Condition : 35 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation) or a resident who it has been demonstrated and verified that they occupied a residential unit within Charlton House, Albany House and Osier Court immediately prior to any residential unit within the development and meet the agreed eligibility criteria, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Details of the eligibility criteria for residents that previously occupied a residential unit within Charlton House, Albany House and Osier Court shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of any residential unit within the development hereby permitted. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.
